name: Question 1
problem:
Consider the finite region $R$ in the $xyz$-space, given by

$$
R=\{(x,y,z)\,:\,1\le x+y\le 2,\,1\le x-y\le 2,\,1\le z\le (x-y)(x+y)\}.
$$

By performing the change of variables

$$
u=x+y,\,v=x-y,\,w=\sqrt{z},
$$

$$
{∭}_{R}3\sqrt{z}\,dV
$$
